description: Jupyter notebooks for Wind Tunnel & Field Wind-Structure Interaction is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jean-Paul Pinelli, Florida Institute of Technology (fit.edu). Florida Tech (FIT) teams deploy networks of wireless sensors on residential houses during high impact wind events or on full scale wind tunnel models. Each deployment might include pressure, temperature and humidity sensors alongside different anemometers and a conical scanning infrared LIDAR. Coverage: Satellite Beach. DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-e0wn-ge12. Keywords: wireless sensors network, Tapis, Plotly, Hurricane Ian, Wall of Wind. Published 2024-04-03. Facility named: Wall of Wind - Florida International University, Wireless sensing network at Florida Tech. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
